evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26hix (AT2026pky) in galaxy NGC 7490 at magnitude m_o = 18.74 +/- 0.12. At a distance of 90 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61207.55 (2026-06-16.55) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.2 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 61205.60. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
